name: Home Assistant Voice smart home migration

mentions.name: Home Assistant Voice smart home migration
mentions.description: This project replaces Alexa with Home Assistant Voice Preview Edition units, tunes their underperforming voice response, and migrates the home's lights and switches to Zigbee with a new hub, at roughly $300 total.
mentions.problem: Alexa had degraded into a central advertising point with weird LLM-y-ness, and the Home Assistant Voice units initially perform worse and need tuning.
mentions.source_excerpt: I got tired of Alexa's slow degradation into a central advertising point and weird LLM-y-ness, so just got some Home Assistant Voice Preview Editions to replace it. Performance is so far worse, so I'll be doing some tuning on that. It also means, unfortunately, replacing a lot of my lights/switches and moving to Zigbee.
